svg.title: Wireless science discovery on a data infrastructure: the group's loop, with an instrument check
svg.desc: A problem-statement driver (diagnose app failures, find the wireless reasons, relate them to architecture decisions; formalized by C0) sits above two layers. Layer II, wireless science discovery: II-A measurement conduction (networks, XCAL collectors, raw chipset bytes and app data recorded outside the tool; a closed post-processor applying procedure theta; our independent decode path) and II-B analysis (II-B1 data analysis; II-B2 the reverse-system loop with a new instrument check at step c). Layer I, data infrastructure: prior containers and standards, C1 Value Passport filled only via C2 tiers from C3 WiReady and C5 drafts, and C4 comparable existing corpora feeding back to II-B. Legend: grey prior work; outlined ours, published; solid ours, pilot evidence; dashed ours, proposed; dotted ours, conditional (C5).
